description: "Hygienic Physiology: with Special Reference to the Use of Alcoholic Drinks and Narcotics" by Joel Dorman Steele is a scientific publication likely written in the late 19th century. This revised edition is intended for educational use in schools and focuses on human physiology, anatomy, and hygiene, particularly emphasizing the impact of alcohol and narcotics on health.
